description: This file defines the main React component for the application's UI, including hooks for backend connection health checks via WebSockets and API, and renders core UI components such as GameBoard, Sidebar, OverlayLayer, and ToastStack. It manages state related to backend connectivity and initiates a new game on startup.

methods.name: useBackendWiring
methods.description: Custom React hook to establish WebSocket connection, monitor API health status, and provide methods to send or reconnect WebSocket.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that sets up the UI layout, manages initial game start, and displays backend status indicators.
